# Autosave

The autosave is an indicator of saving in a context. It can replace the component, or appear near the action.
See <a className="sbk-link" href="https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/autosave/design/" target="_blank">Loading guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i></a>
